-- WindLeaves.lua  (Server Script)
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- CONFIG
local treePath = script.Parent               -- set this to workspace.YourTreeModel if script not parented to the tree
local leavesFolderName = "Leaves"            -- folder name under treePath
local windStrength = 4                  -- base angle multiplier (tweak)
local windSpeed = 1.0                        -- speed multiplier (tweak)
local enforceAnchored = true                 -- set true to auto Anchor leaves (recommended)
local debugEnabled = true

-- Helper debug
local function debug(...)
	if debugEnabled then
		print("[WindLeaves]", ...)
	end
end

-- Find Leaves folder
local function findLeavesFolder()
	if not treePath then return nil end
	local folder = treePath:FindFirstChild(leavesFolderName)
	if folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then
		return folder
	end
	-- fallback: try to find any descendant folder named Leaves
	for _, v in pairs(treePath:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == leavesFolderName and v:IsA("Folder") then
			return v
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local LeavesFolder = findLeavesFolder()
if not LeavesFolder then
	debug("ERROR: Leaves folder not found under", treePath:GetFullName())
	return
end
debug("Found Leaves folder at", LeavesFolder:GetFullName())

-- Table to hold parts and their originals + random offset
local leafData = {}

local function addLeaf(part)
	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	if leafData[part] then return end
	leafData[part] = {
		orig = part.CFrame,
		offset = math.random() * 1000,    -- unique time offset so leaves don't move perfectly in sync
	}
	if enforceAnchored then
		part.Anchored = true
	end
	debug("Added leaf:", part:GetFullName())
end

local function removeLeaf(part)
	if leafData[part] then
		leafData[part] = nil
		debug("Removed leaf:", part:GetFullName())
	end
end

-- Initialize existing children
for _, child in ipairs(LeavesFolder:GetChildren()) do
	addLeaf(child)
end

-- React to runtime changes
LeavesFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	-- wait a short tick in case child is a Model with parts inside
	task.wait(0.01)
	-- if child is a folder/model, add parts inside
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		addLeaf(child)
	else
		for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				addLeaf(desc)
			end
		end
	end
end)

LeavesFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
	-- remove whichever parts belonged to that child (or the child itself)
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		removeLeaf(child)
	else
		for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				removeLeaf(desc)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Also remove when parts are destroyed
game:GetService("Workspace").DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc and desc:IsA("BasePart") and leafData[desc] then
		leafData[desc] = nil
		debug("Leaf destroyed:", desc:GetFullName())
	end
end)

-- Main update loop (Heartbeat for smooth motion)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local t = tick() * windSpeed
	for part, info in pairs(leafData) do
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			leafData[part] = nil
		else
			-- compute small rotations based on noise / trig
			local clock = t + info.offset
			-- small independent axes
			local rx = math.rad(math.cos(clock) * windStrength)
			local ry = math.rad(math.sin(clock * 0.9) * windStrength * 0.6)
			local rz = math.rad(math.cos(clock * 1.1) * windStrength * 0.5)
			part.CFrame = info.orig * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
		end
	end
end)

debug("WindLeaves script started. Leaf count:", (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(leafData) do c=c+1 end; return c end)())

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (config ~= nil) then
--		print("Loading anims " .. name)
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject == nil) then
					animTable[name][idx].weight = 1
				else
					animTable[name][idx].weight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
	--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId .. " (" .. animTable[name][idx].weight .. ")")
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end
	return oldAnim
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
		currentAnimSpeed = speed
		currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then

		local repeatAnim = currentAnim
		-- return to idle if finishing an emote
		if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
			repeatAnim = "idle"
		end
		
		local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
		playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.0, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
	end
end

-- Preload animations
function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 
		
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
--		print(animName .. " " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
	end

end

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)	 
		
		local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
		local origRoll = roll
		local idx = 1
		while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
			roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
			idx = idx + 1
		end
--		print(animName .. " * " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

		if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then
			
			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
				toolAnimTrack:Stop()
				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation
			toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then

		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end


	return oldAnim

local lastTick = 0

function move(time)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = time - lastTick
  	lastTick = time

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

-- Keep the secret brick hidden, but always place it above valid ground so it is findable.
local function placeCollectibleAboveGround()
	local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	if not spawn then return end

	-- Hidden off to the side/back of the starting area rather than directly beside spawn.
	local targetXZ = spawn.Position + Vector3.new(-48, 0, -38)
	local rayOrigin = Vector3.new(targetXZ.X, 150, targetXZ.Z)
	local rayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -300, 0)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {collectible}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, params)
	if result then
		local halfHeight = collectible.Size.Y * 0.5
		collectible.Position = result.Position + Vector3.new(0, halfHeight + 0.35, 0)
	else
		collectible.Position = Vector3.new(targetXZ.X, spawn.Position.Y + 2, targetXZ.Z)
	end
end

local active = {}
local connections = {}

local function applyBuffs(player, isUnlocked)
	player:SetAttribute("FollowBrickUnlocked", isUnlocked == true)
	player:SetAttribute("StrengthMultiplier", isUnlocked and 1.05 or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("MoneyMultiplier", isUnlocked and 1.05 or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("XPMultiplier", isUnlocked and 1.05 or 1)
end

local function clearFollower(player)
	local state = active[player]
	if state then
		if state.brick and state.brick.Parent then
			state.brick:Destroy()
		end
		active[player] = nil
	end
end

local function spawnFollower(player, character)
	clearFollower(player)
	if not unlocked[player] then return end

	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not root or not character.Parent then return end

	local brick = collectible:Clone()
	brick.Name = "Float Brick Follower"
	brick.Anchored = true
	brick.CanCollide = false
	brick.CanTouch = false
	brick.CanQuery = false
	for _, obj in ipairs(brick:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("ClickDetector") then obj:Destroy() end
		if obj:IsA("Script") or obj:IsA("LocalScript") then obj.Disabled = true end
	end
	brick.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(2.5, 1.5, 4.5)
	brick.Parent = workspace
	active[player] = {brick = brick, root = root, elapsed = 0}
end

local function saveUnlock(player)
	local key = "u_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		unlockStore:UpdateAsync(key, function()
			return true
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[FollowBrick] Could not save permanent unlock for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function unlockForPlayer(player)
	if unlocked[player] then return end
	unlocked[player] = true
	applyBuffs(player, true)
	saveUnlock(player)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(spawnFollower, player, player.Character)
	end
end

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(unlockForPlayer)

local function addPlayer(player)
	applyBuffs(player, false)

	local key = "u_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return unlockStore:GetAsync(key)
	end)
	if ok and result == true then
		unlocked[player] = true
		applyBuffs(player, true)
	elseif not ok then
		warn("[FollowBrick] Could not load permanent unlock for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(result))
	end

	local added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		spawnFollower(player, character)
	end)
	local removing = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		clearFollower(player)
	end)
	connections[player] = {added, removing}

	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(spawnFollower, player, player.Character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(addPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	clearFollower(player)
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections[player] or {}) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	connections[player] = nil
	unlocked[player] = nil
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(addPlayer, player)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for player, state in pairs(active) do
		local root, brick = state.root, state.brick
		if root and brick and root.Parent and brick.Parent and player.Character == root.Parent then
			state.elapsed += dt
			local bob = math.sin(state.elapsed * 2.6) * 0.35
			local target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(2.5, 1.5 + bob, 4.5)
			local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-7 * dt)
			brick.CFrame = brick.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha)
		else
			clearFollower(player)
		end
	end
end)

local function ensureInt(folder, name, defaultValue)
	local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not value then
		value = Instance.new("IntValue")
		value.Name = name
		value.Value = defaultValue
		value.Parent = folder
	end
	return value
end

local function setup(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		stats.Parent = player
	end

	ensureInt(stats, "Level", 1)
	ensureInt(stats, "XP", 0)

	-- Coins and Gems should not appear on Roblox's player leaderboard.
	local currency = player:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then
		currency = Instance.new("Folder")
		currency.Name = "Currency"
		currency.Parent = player
	end
	ensureInt(currency, "Coins", 0)
	ensureInt(currency, "Gems", 0)

	-- Remove old leaderboard currency values if they exist from a previous version.
	for _, name in {"Coins", "Gems", "XPToNextLevel"} do
		local old = stats:FindFirstChild(name)
		if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function applyRewardMultiplier(player, amount, attributeName)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute(attributeName)) or 1
	return math.floor(amount * multiplier + 0.5)
end

local function awardQuest(player, quest)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local currency = player:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not stats or not currency then return end

	local level = stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
	local xp = stats:FindFirstChild("XP")
	local coins = currency:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not level or not xp or not coins then return end

	local xpReward = applyRewardMultiplier(player, quest.xp, "XPMultiplier")
	local coinReward = applyRewardMultiplier(player, quest.coins, "MoneyMultiplier")
	coins.Value += coinReward
	xp.Value += xpReward

	while xp.Value >= xpNeededForLevel(level.Value) do
		local needed = xpNeededForLevel(level.Value)
		xp.Value -= needed
		level.Value += 1
	end
end

local function activeQuestInfo(s)
	if s.ashenAccepted and not s.ashenCompleted then
		return QUESTS.AshenPup, "ashenKills", "ashenCompleted"
	end
	if s.wolfAccepted and not s.wolfCompleted then
		return QUESTS.WolfScout, "wolfKills", "wolfCompleted"
	end
	return nil
end

local function offerQuest(player, s, questKey)
	local quest = QUESTS[questKey]
	s.pendingQuest = questKey
	send(player, "Story", {
		text = string.format("I have another job for you. Defeat %d %s%s. Reward: %d coins and %d XP.", quest.required, questKey == "AshenPup" and "AshenPup" or "WolfScout", quest.required == 1 and "" or "s", quest.coins, quest.xp),
		button = "Accept quest",
	})
end

local function talk(player)
	local s = state[player]
	if not s or not nearby(player) then return end

	if s.stage == "math" then
		send(player, "Question", {
			question = "Welcome, " .. player.DisplayName .. ". One quick test: what's 9 + 10?",
			answers = {"19", "21", "910"},
		})
	elseif s.stage == "offer" then
		send(player, "Story", {
			text = "You have potential, " .. player.DisplayName .. ". Take this sword and defeat the training enemy to begin your slayer journey.",
			button = "Accept sword & quest",
		})
	elseif s.stage == "hunt" then
		grantSword(player)
		send(player, "Story", {
			text = "Equip your Novice Slayer Sword and defeat the training enemy near me. Click or tap to attack!",
			button = "Let's go",
		})
	elseif s.stage == "return" then
		s.stage = "done"
		send(player, "Story", {
			text = "Well done, " .. player.DisplayName .. "! You defeated your first enemy. Your slayer journey has officially begun! Come talk to me again when you're ready for real work.",
			button = "Thank you!",
		})
	else
		local quest, killsField, completedField = activeQuestInfo(s)
		if quest then
			local kills = s[killsField] or 0
			if kills >= quest.required then
				s[completedField] = true
				awardQuest(player, quest)
				s.pendingQuest = nil
				send(player, "Story", {
					text = string.format("Good work. %s complete! You earned %d coins and %d XP.", quest.title, quest.coins, quest.xp),
					button = "Collect reward",
				})
			else
				send(player, "Story", {
					text = string.format("%s progress: %d/%d. Keep hunting and come back when the job is finished.", quest.title, kills, quest.required),
					button = "Back to hunting",
				})
			end
		elseif not s.ashenCompleted then
			offerQuest(player, s, "AshenPup")
		elseif not s.wolfCompleted then
			offerQuest(player, s, "WolfScout")
		else
			send(player, "Story", {
				text = "You've handled both hunts well, " .. player.DisplayName .. ". Keep training. I'll have tougher work for you soon.",
				button = "Goodbye",
			})
		end
	end
end

		end

local function bindEnemy(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") or model:GetAttribute("TetsuQuestBound") then return end
	local enemyType = model:GetAttribute("SpawnEnemyType")
	if enemyType ~= "AshenPup" and enemyType ~= "WolfScout" then return end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	model:SetAttribute("TetsuQuestBound", true)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		local userId = humanoid:GetAttribute("LastHitUserId")
		local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local s = player and state[player]
		if not s or s.stage ~= "done" then return end

		if enemyType == "AshenPup" and s.ashenAccepted and not s.ashenCompleted then
			s.ashenKills = math.min((s.ashenKills or 0) + 1, QUESTS.AshenPup.required)
			if s.ashenKills >= QUESTS.AshenPup.required then
				send(player, "Quest", {text = "AshenPup Hunt complete! Return to Tetsu for your reward."})
			end
		elseif enemyType == "WolfScout" and s.wolfAccepted and not s.wolfCompleted then
			s.wolfKills = math.min((s.wolfKills or 0) + 1, QUESTS.WolfScout.required)
			if s.wolfKills >= QUESTS.WolfScout.required then
				send(player, "Quest", {text = "Wolf Hunt complete! Return to Tetsu for your reward."})
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function resolveEnemyConfig()
	local configsFolder = assets:FindFirstChild("Configs")
	local primary = configsFolder and configsFolder:FindFirstChild("EnemyConfig")
	if primary and primary:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, primary)
		if ok then return result end
		warn("[CombatSystem] Could not require Assets.Configs.EnemyConfig: " .. tostring(result))
	end

	local gameShared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameShared")
	local fallback = gameShared and gameShared:FindFirstChild("EnemyConfig")
	if fallback and fallback:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		warn("[CombatSystem] Using GameShared.EnemyConfig fallback. Restart Rojo to load Assets.Configs.EnemyConfig.")
		return require(fallback)
	end

	error("[CombatSystem] EnemyConfig missing from both Assets.Configs and GameShared")
end

local function xpNeededForLevel(level)
	return 100 + math.max(0, level - 1) * 50
end

local function awardPlayer(player, xpAmount, coinAmount)
	local stats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local level = stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
	local xp = stats:FindFirstChild("XP")
	local coins = stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not level or not xp or not coins then return end

	coins.Value += coinAmount
	xp.Value += xpAmount
	while xp.Value >= xpNeededForLevel(level.Value) do
		local needed = xpNeededForLevel(level.Value)
		xp.Value -= needed
		level.Value += 1
	end
end

local function randomReward(range, fallback)
	if type(range) ~= "table" then return fallback or 0 end
	local minValue = tonumber(range.Min) or fallback or 0
	local maxValue = tonumber(range.Max) or minValue
	if maxValue < minValue then minValue, maxValue = maxValue, minValue end
	return math.random(math.floor(minValue), math.floor(maxValue))
end

local animationCache = {}
local function resolveAnimation(name)
	if animationCache[name] then return animationCache[name] end
	for _, obj in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.Name == name and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
			animationCache[name] = obj
			return obj
		end
	end
	local sequence = animSaves:FindFirstChild(name)
	if sequence and sequence:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		local ok, id = pcall(function()
			return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(sequence)
		end)
		if ok and id then
			local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			anim.Name = name
			anim.AnimationId = id
			animationCache[name] = anim
			return anim
		end
	end
	warn("[CombatSystem] Animation not available: " .. name)
	return nil
end

local function loadTrack(animator, name, priority, looped)
	local anim = resolveAnimation(name)
	if not anim then return nil end
	local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
	if not ok then return nil end
	track.Priority = priority
	track.Looped = looped
	return track
end

local function setupNpcAnimations(humanoid)
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Parent = humanoid
	local tracks = {
		idle = loadTrack(animator, "Sword Idle", Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle, true),
		walk = loadTrack(animator, "Sword Walk", Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement, true),
		attacks = {},
	}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		tracks.attacks[i] = loadTrack(animator, "Attack" .. i, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action, false)
	end
	return tracks
end

local function setMoving(tracks, moving)
	if moving then
		if tracks.idle and tracks.idle.IsPlaying then tracks.idle:Stop(0.15) end
		if tracks.walk and not tracks.walk.IsPlaying then tracks.walk:Play(0.15) end
	else
		if tracks.walk and tracks.walk.IsPlaying then tracks.walk:Stop(0.15) end
		if tracks.idle and not tracks.idle.IsPlaying then tracks.idle:Play(0.15) end
	end
end

local function playDifferentAttack(tracks, lastIndex)
	local choices = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if i ~= lastIndex and tracks.attacks[i] then table.insert(choices, i) end
	end
	if #choices == 0 then return lastIndex end
	local index = choices[math.random(1, #choices)]
	tracks.attacks[index]:Play(0.08, 1, 1)
	return index
end

local function nearestPlayer(position, aggroDistance)
	local bestPlayer, bestRoot, bestHum, bestDistance
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance <= aggroDistance and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
				bestPlayer, bestRoot, bestHum, bestDistance = player, root, hum, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPlayer, bestRoot, bestHum, bestDistance
end

local function spawnEnemy(enemyName, point)
	local config = EnemyConfig[enemyName]
	local template = templates[enemyName]
	if not config or not template or not point:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = config.ModelName or enemyName
	model:SetAttribute("EnemyNPC", true)
	model:SetAttribute("SpawnEnemyType", enemyName)
	model.Parent = enemyFolder

	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
	if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		warn("[CombatSystem] " .. enemyName .. " needs a Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart")
		model:Destroy()
		return
	end

	model.PrimaryPart = root
	model:PivotTo(point.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
			pcall(function() part:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
		end
	end

	humanoid.MaxHealth = config.Health
	humanoid.Health = config.Health
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = config.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOn
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer

	local home = root.Position
	local tracks = setupNpcAnimations(humanoid)
	equipNpcSword(model, humanoid)
	setMoving(tracks, false)

	local alive = true
	local lastAttackTime = 0
	local lastAttackIndex = 0

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		alive = false
		local userId = humanoid:GetAttribute("LastHitUserId")
		local killer = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if killer then
			local xpReward = randomReward(config.XPReward, 0)
			local coinsConfig = config.PossibleRewards and config.PossibleRewards.Coins
			local coinReward = randomReward(coinsConfig, 0)
			awardPlayer(killer, xpReward, coinReward)
		end

		task.delay(config.RespawnTime, function()
			if point.Parent then spawnEnemy(enemyName, point) end
		end)
		task.delay(2, function()
			if model.Parent then model:Destroy() end
		end)
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while alive and model.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			local leashDistance = config.LeashDistance
			local attackRange = config.AttackRange
			local homeDistance = (root.Position - home).Magnitude
			local _, targetRoot, targetHum, targetDistance = nearestPlayer(root.Position, config.AggroRange)

			if homeDistance > leashDistance + 0.75 then
				humanoid:MoveTo(home)
				setMoving(tracks, true)
			elseif targetRoot and targetHum and targetDistance then
				local targetFromHome = targetRoot.Position - home
				if targetFromHome.Magnitude > leashDistance + attackRange then
					humanoid:MoveTo(home)
					setMoving(tracks, homeDistance > 1.5)
				elseif targetDistance <= attackRange then
					humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
					setMoving(tracks, false)
					if os.clock() - lastAttackTime >= config.AttackCooldown then

local function randomReward(range)
	if type(range) ~= "table" then return 0 end
	local minimum = tonumber(range.Min) or 0
	local maximum = tonumber(range.Max) or minimum
	if maximum < minimum then minimum, maximum = maximum, minimum end
	return math.random(math.floor(minimum), math.floor(maximum))
end

local function boostedAmount(player, baseAmount, multiplierAttribute, carryAttribute)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute(multiplierAttribute)) or 1
	local carry = tonumber(player:GetAttribute(carryAttribute)) or 0
	local exact = (baseAmount * multiplier) + carry
	local whole = math.floor(exact)
	player:SetAttribute(carryAttribute, exact - whole)
	return whole
end

local function award(player, config)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local currency = player:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not stats or not currency then return end

	local level = stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
	local xp = stats:FindFirstChild("XP")
	local coins = currency:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not level or not xp or not coins then return end

	local baseXP = randomReward(config.XPReward)
	local coinConfig = config.PossibleRewards and config.PossibleRewards.Coins
	local baseCoins = randomReward(coinConfig)

	xp.Value += boostedAmount(player, baseXP, "XPMultiplier", "XPBoostCarry")
	coins.Value += boostedAmount(player, baseCoins, "MoneyMultiplier", "MoneyBoostCarry")

	while xp.Value >= xpNeededForLevel(level.Value) do
		local needed = xpNeededForLevel(level.Value)
		xp.Value -= needed
		level.Value += 1
	end
end

		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}

local lastTick = 0

function move(time)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = time - lastTick
  	lastTick = time

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

-- Preserve one untouched copy of the Studio-authored VFX before hiding the
-- Workspace template locally. Runtime attacks clone this preserved source.
local slashSourceTemplate = nil
if slashTemplate and slashTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then
	slashSourceTemplate = slashTemplate:Clone()
	slashSourceTemplate.Name = "Slash Particle Source"
	slashTemplate.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	for _, obj in ipairs(slashTemplate:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Enabled = false
		end
	end

local animationCache = {}
local function resolveAnimation(name)
	if animationCache[name] then return animationCache[name] end
	for _, obj in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.Name == name and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
			animationCache[name] = obj
			return obj
		end
	end
	local sequence = animSaves:FindFirstChild(name)
	if sequence and sequence:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		local ok, id = pcall(function()
			return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(sequence)
		end)
		if ok and id then
			local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			anim.Name = name
			anim.AnimationId = id
			animationCache[name] = anim
			return anim
		end
	end
	warn("[SwordCombat] Missing animation: " .. name)
	return nil
end

local function loadTrack(animator, name, priority, looped)
	local anim = resolveAnimation(name)
	if not anim then return nil end
	local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
	if not ok then return nil end
	track.Priority = priority
	track.Looped = looped
	return track
end

-- Placement only. The VFX itself comes directly from Workspace > Slash Particle.
-- Its visual angle is controlled entirely by the Studio asset (Attachment/emitter),
-- so the script does not add an extra roll rotation anymore.
local SLASH_DISTANCE = 1.75
local SLASH_HEIGHT = 0.65
local SLASH_SIDE_OFFSET = 0
local SLASH_LIFETIME = 1.5
local SLASH_DELAY = 0.09
local SLASH_EMIT_WINDOW = 0.12

local function emitSlash(tool)
	if not slashSourceTemplate or not slashSourceTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or tool.Parent ~= character then return end

	-- Clone the preserved Studio asset exactly as it was authored at play start.
	local slash = slashSourceTemplate:Clone()
	slash.Name = "Player Slash Particle"
	slash.Anchored = true
	slash.CanCollide = false
	slash.CanTouch = false
	slash.CanQuery = false
	slash.CastShadow = false
	slash.Transparency = 1
	slash.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0

	-- Always place it on the player's forward side using the character's facing,
	-- never the camera direction.
	local forward = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
	local slashPosition = root.Position
		+ forward * SLASH_DISTANCE
		+ right * SLASH_SIDE_OFFSET
		+ Vector3.new(0, SLASH_HEIGHT, 0)
	slash.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(slashPosition, slashPosition + forward, root.CFrame.UpVector)
	slash.Parent = workspace

	-- Keep emission on the forward face only so the effect cannot alternate to the
	-- player's back side. Other visual properties still come from the Studio asset.
	for _, obj in ipairs(slash:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
			obj.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			obj.LockedToPart = true

			if obj.Enabled then
				task.delay(SLASH_EMIT_WINDOW, function()
					if obj.Parent then
						obj.Enabled = false
					end
				end)
			else
				local emitCount = obj:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
				if typeof(emitCount) ~= "number" then
					emitCount = math.max(1, math.round(math.max(obj.Rate, 1) * SLASH_EMIT_WINDOW))
				end
				obj:Emit(emitCount)
			end
		end
	end

	Debris:AddItem(slash, SLASH_LIFETIME)
end

local function bindSword(tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
	if not tool:GetAttribute("SlayerSword") and tool.Name ~= "Novice Slayer Sword" then return end
	if tool:GetAttribute("CombatClientBound") then return end
	tool:SetAttribute("CombatClientBound", true)

	local equipped = false
	local attacking = false
	local unsheathing = false
	local humanoid, animator
	local idleTrack, walkTrack, unsheathTrack
	local attackTracks = {}
	local runningConnection
	local lastAttackIndex = 0
	local lastAttackTime = 0
	local equipToken = 0

	local function stopTrack(track, fade)
		if track and track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(fade or 0.1) end
	end

	local function setLocomotion(speed)
		if not equipped or attacking or unsheathing then return end
		if speed > 0.5 then
			stopTrack(idleTrack, 0.15)
			if walkTrack and not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play(0.15) end
		else
			stopTrack(walkTrack, 0.15)
			if idleTrack and not idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Play(0.15) end
		end
	end

	local function clearTracks()
		if runningConnection then runningConnection:Disconnect() runningConnection = nil end
		stopTrack(unsheathTrack, 0.05)
		stopTrack(idleTrack, 0.1)
		stopTrack(walkTrack, 0.1)
		for _, track in pairs(attackTracks) do stopTrack(track, 0.05) end
		unsheathTrack, idleTrack, walkTrack = nil, nil, nil
		table.clear(attackTracks)
		humanoid, animator = nil, nil
	end

	local function setupTracks()
		clearTracks()
		local character = player.Character
		humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then return end
		animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
		unsheathTrack = loadTrack(animator, "UnsheathingSword", Enum.AnimationPriority.Action, false)
		idleTrack = loadTrack(animator, "Sword Idle", Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle, true)
		walkTrack = loadTrack(animator, "Sword Walk", Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement, true)
		for i = 1, 5 do
			attackTracks[i] = loadTrack(animator, "Attack" .. i, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action, false)
		end
		runningConnection = humanoid.Running:Connect(setLocomotion)
	end

	local function chooseAttack()
		local choices = {}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if i ~= lastAttackIndex and attackTracks[i] then table.insert(choices, i) end
		end
		if #choices == 0 then return nil end
		local index = choices[math.random(1, #choices)]
		lastAttackIndex = index
		return index
	end

	tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
		equipped = true
		attacking = false
		unsheathing = true
		equipToken += 1
		local thisEquip = equipToken
		setupTracks()
		stopTrack(idleTrack, 0)
		stopTrack(walkTrack, 0)

		if unsheathTrack then
			unsheathTrack:Play(0.06, 1, 1)
			local duration = 0.65
			if unsheathTrack.Length > 0 then duration = math.clamp(unsheathTrack.Length, 0.25, 2) end
			task.delay(duration, function()
				if not equipped or thisEquip ~= equipToken then return end
				unsheathing = false
				if humanoid then
					setLocomotion(humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude * humanoid.WalkSpeed)
				end
			end)
		else
			unsheathing = false
			if humanoid then setLocomotion(humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude * humanoid.WalkSpeed) end
		end
	end)

	tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
		equipped = false
		attacking = false
		unsheathing = false
		equipToken += 1
		clearTracks()
	end)

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not equipped or attacking or unsheathing then return end
		if os.clock() - lastAttackTime < 0.42 then return end
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or tool.Parent ~= character then return end
		local index = chooseAttack()
		if not index then return end
		lastAttackTime = os.clock()
		attacking = true
		stopTrack(idleTrack, 0.08)
		stopTrack(walkTrack, 0.08)
		local track = attackTracks[index]
		if track then track:Play(0.06, 1, 1) end

		task.delay(SLASH_DELAY, function()
			if equipped and tool.Parent == player.Character then
				emitSlash(tool)
			end
		end)

		combatRemote:FireServer(index)
		local duration = 0.48
		if track and track.Length > 0 then duration = math.clamp(track.Length * 0.75, 0.32, 0.8) end
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if not equipped then return end
			attacking = false
			if humanoid then
				setLocomotion(humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude * humanoid.WalkSpeed)
			end
		end)
	end)

	tool.Destroying:Connect(clearTracks)
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (config ~= nil) then
--		print("Loading anims " .. name)
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject == nil) then
					animTable[name][idx].weight = 1
				else
					animTable[name][idx].weight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
	--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId .. " (" .. animTable[name][idx].weight .. ")")
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

		oldAnim = "idle"

		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end
	return oldAnim
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
		currentAnimSpeed = speed
		currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then

		local repeatAnim = currentAnim
		-- return to idle if finishing an emote
		if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
			repeatAnim = "idle"
		end
		
		local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
		playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.0, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
	end
end

-- Preload animations
function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 
		
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
--		print(animName .. " " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
	end

end

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)	 
		
		local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
		local origRoll = roll
		local idx = 1
		while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
			roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
			idx = idx + 1
		end
--		print(animName .. " * " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

		if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then
			
			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
				toolAnimTrack:Stop()
				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation
			toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end


	return oldAnim
end

local lastTick = 0

function move(time)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = time - lastTick
  	lastTick = time

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end
